title: Patch 2.2: ECL Hub and a fresh ranked season
summary: ECL Hub for Windows, an upcoming 800 LP ranked reset and a clearer KOOK reporting flow. The ladder ends 14 January 2027, with merchandise for first place and 300/150 RMB for second and third.

blocks.text: Patch 2.2 brings the ECL Hub desktop app, a fresh ranked ladder and a clearer KOOK reporting flow. Everyone will begin the next season at **800 LP**, with prizes for the top three players when the ladder ends on **14 January 2027**.
The season start and reporting activation will be announced in KOOK. This preview does not mark the beginning of the new ladder.
ECL Hub for Windows
ECL Hub puts your ECL profile, ranked ladder, inhouse history and saved League history in a native desktop app, with English and Chinese support.

items: Sign in with your existing ECL account.
View match scoreboards with team statistics, damage bars and recorded MVP/SVP awards where available.
Check saved League ranks and champion snapshots, with source/update labels.
Collect completed matches locally, with retries when the League connection or match service is unavailable.
Connect reporting separately to upload an assigned inhouse for administrator review when your reporter profile is enabled.

blocks.text: The Windows installer will be pinned in **ECL HUB DESKTOP APP** on KOOK. There is no separate website installer download for this rollout.
If League runs as administrator, keep the installer's administrator launch option selected so Hub can connect. Windows may ask you to approve the launch.
Ranked reset
The next season starts everyone at **800 LP**. Season wins, losses and streaks restart from zero. **Old match history stays available.**
The opening three-game placement bonus is removed. Normal scoring applies from game one, including ordinary win/loss streaks. There is no opening +65 LP win bonus or placement-loss protection.

headers: Normal result, before streaks and other modifiers

blocks.text: The remaining LP rules stay in place:

items: **Winning streaks:** consecutive wins 3–5 give +44 each, or +48 with MVP. Win 6 onward gives +59, or +63 with MVP, before other modifiers.
**Losing streaks:** the third consecutive loss is -20, the fourth -22, increasing by 2 for each further consecutive loss. SVP reduces the loss by 3.
**Thursday/Friday bonus:** the first ranked game of the day has doubled winning LP if it is a win, using China time. A first-game loss uses that day's opportunity; a later win is not doubled.
**Higher ratings:** above 1400 effective LP, wins lose 1 LP per complete 25 above 1400, and losses increase by 1 per complete 35 above 1400.

**Inactivity:** after seven inactive China calendar days, decay is 10 LP per additional day and stops at 600. Match losses can still take LP below 600. Old-season inactivity does not carry into a fresh zero-game record.

blocks.text: For example, three opening wins without MVP or other modifiers give: **800 → 829 → 858 → 902 LP**. The third win earns the normal streak bonus.
KOOK and Hub reporting
The new flow keeps KOOK for organising the game and uses the participating reporter's Hub to collect the match:
**!inhouse → !ready → play → !report IH_NUMBER GAME_ID → Hub upload → admin review**

All ten players need verified, active ECL profiles with matching Ionia Riot IDs. At least one participant must have Hub installed and connected, with reporting enabled. **The person sending !report must be that reporter.**

items: **!hub:** installer location and setup instructions.
**!status IH_NUMBER:** collection and review progress for that game.
**!no IH_NUMBER:** cancel your own unsubmitted report request.
**!cancel IH_NUMBER:** administrator cancellation of a specific inhouse.
**!inhouse** and **!report** include Hub reminders. An unclaimed request gets a one-time waiting reminder while the bot remains running.
App reports no longer use **!yes** to submit a result.

blocks.text: Local collection, an uploaded match and an official ranked result are separate states. **Uploading or marking an upload reviewed does not automatically award LP or create an official ranked result.** The reporting rollout begins with enabled pilot reporters and administrator review.
Ladder finish and prizes
The ranked ladder ends **14 January 2027**. The exact closing time, season start and final standings/eligibility details will be announced in KOOK before the season begins.

rows: Signed Faker merchandise or other pro-player merchandise, subject to availability

blocks.text: That is **450 RMB in cash prizes, plus the first-place merchandise prize**. Watch KOOK for the start notice, install Hub and get your account ready.

title: Meet ECL Hub: your ECL desktop app
summary: Your ECL profile, ranked ladder, match scoreboards and saved League history in a Windows app. Find the tester installer in ECL HUB DESKTOP APP on KOOK; reporting activation will be announced separately.

blocks.text: We’re bringing ECL to your desktop with **ECL Hub for Windows**: one place for your profile, ranked ladder, inhouse scoreboards and saved League history.

Use your existing ECL login, choose English or Chinese, and keep Hub alongside League while you play. You can inspect match statistics, view recorded awards, check saved League snapshots and collect completed games on your own PC.

The Windows installer will be pinned in **ECL HUB DESKTOP APP** on KOOK (channel **5590769063605712**). The first tester package is **1.0.1**; **Patch 2.2** is the wider ECL community update, not the desktop app's version number.
A simpler reporting flow
The upcoming reporting pilot connects KOOK to your desktop collector:

items: Organise the inhouse with **!inhouse** and **!ready**.
Play with the ten verified players on their assigned sides.
The participating Hub reporter sends **!report IH_NUMBER GAME_ID**.
Their connected Hub collects the assigned game and uploads it for administrator review.

blocks.text: Only the designated reporter needs collection running. All ten players still need verified ECL profiles. Reporting must be explicitly connected in Collector and enabled for the reporter’s profile.

**Saved locally does not mean reported. Uploaded does not mean scored.** Uploads and review receipts do not automatically create official results or award LP. We’ll announce when the reporting pilot is enabled.
A fresh ladder to climb

Alongside Patch 2.2, the next ranked season will reset everyone to **800 LP**, with fresh records and streaks. Your old match history stays available, and normal LP scoring applies from game one without the three-game placement bonus.
The ladder ends **14 January 2027**, with **signed Faker merchandise or other pro-player merchandise, subject to availability**, for first place, **300 RMB** for second and **150 RMB** for third.
The start date, exact closing time and final season details will follow in KOOK. Get your ECL account verified and watch the app channel for the installer and pinned setup guide.
